svg.title: Pulsus Dash — Segments view, region × service tier matrix
svg.desc: Segments view (Alt+5): a matrix of regions × service tiers. Each cell shows the worst health state (colour + glyph), incident and alert counts and a sparkline. Rows are sorted by care score. eu-west-1 × Tier 0 is the origin cell for INC-2041; downstream cells are dashed victims; LON-DC2 is hatched Unknown. The Inspector breaks down the selected cell.
svg.text: Filter env=prod · team=any · sev≥SEV3 · state=firing,pending ☐ show silenced ☐ show acked (1 hidden… shown dimmed)

g.text: ⊕ contains the probable origin of INC-2041
Rows ranked by care, not A–Z
